'''Modt''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] inspector in the [[Coruscanti Immigration Service]]. He was responsible for finding [[Neutron Pixie|neutron pixie]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] which undercover [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bazel Warv]] was carrying.
